If retesting, note that /app/backend/pytest.ini enables xdist by default — this specific file must be run either single-worker (pass '-o addopts=') or the sequential-scope will make gw0 run all 4 tests anyway; parallel restarts across workers would race, so keep this file's tests to one worker.
rca of the issue: Root cause: preview seeded superadmin@ithr.online, but the production DB still had the legacy superadmin@ithr.tech doc, so canonical-email login failed with 'Invalid credentials'. Fix (seed_super_admin.py lines ~64-98): every boot, if existing super_admin.email != SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL env, rename to canonical (guarded by a lookup on the target email to avoid unique-index clashes). If a clash exists, an ERROR is logged and rename is skipped; password re-sync continues. Reproduction confirmed: (a) set super_admin.email='superadmin@ithr.tech' in Mongo -> restart -> email re-synced to 'superadmin@ithr.online', login 200. (b) with a clash learner holding the canonical email, restart -> rename skipped, ERROR log emitted, password re-sync intact, login with legacy email 200. Mitigation deployed: production redeploy will now auto-rename the super_admin doc to the canonical address on next boot.
